purpose: Before/after measurement of the Studio console event window against the operator's live state. Read-only queries; no event was rewritten.

before_fix.query: ORDER BY e.recorded_at ASC, e.seq ASC LIMIT 200

after_fix.query: newest 200 by recorded_at DESC, rowid DESC, then re-ordered oldest-first

reproduction.case: keeps the newest event window so a long thread keeps following the turn
reproduction.new_query_result: 200 events, seq 51-250, then 251 after the next event
